extras: Warning in README: main.js is about 9.2 MiB, exceeding Obsidian Sync's 5 MB per-file limit, so the plugin is not synced through Obsidian Sync and must be installed or updated via the community catalog, BRAT, or manual copy. Built-in tools default to Allow, including writing, deleting notes, and changing plugins; Safe mode with Ask settings is recommended before first use. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13.1+. Local embeddings need an initial model download. Optional sponsorship via Afdian and Ko-fi; Apache-2.0 license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in assistant that can read vault notes, take actions like installing plugins or writing notes, and answer with openable citations.
